claims.text: R3 is enforced in three places. metrics.compute raises ReconciliationError, a ValueError carrying difference_pence and the line ids in statement order, in three cases: the buckets do not sum to M17; a credit is in no bucket or in more than one; or a non-credit line is counted as trading receipts. `cma run` catches the error and exits 6 with 'Refused, no figures shown.', the difference in pence and the line ids, before any memo is written. MCP compute_metrics returns M1..M26 and raises the same error for such a case. The contract tests cover the CLI (a credit forced into a category with no bucket) and MCP.

M1-M16 keep their ids, units, values and evidence on every committed synthetic case, fixture and golden. This holds for the P7 v1 baseline, the P7 v2 corpus and the previous-release dual-run comparison, after moving M1-M16 to pence arithmetic.
The full suite, every invariants test, ruff, compileall and the offline evals under v1 and v2 all pass.

notes:
Test edits: tests/test_previous_release.py compared every metric with the previous release. It now compares M1-M16 only, as its name says, because M17-M26 have no previous value. It also allows M16's method sentence to change beside M2's, because M16's denominator now also leaves out own-account transfers (design: M16 and M26 share one denominator). Neither the synthetic cases nor the example has an own-account credit, so no M16 value moves (the dual_run tier proves it).

Exit code: cma run uses exit 6 for a reconciliation refusal. Exit 2 is a refusal of the inputs, 3 a memo that cannot be approved, and 4 a model failure. Without the new handler the error was reported as a model failure (exit 4).

R2 pence arithmetic now covers M1-M16 as well: sums, offsets, M3 (total * 1461 / (48 * days)), and the M4, M10, M15, M16 and M26 ratios, which are rounded half to even from the exact quotient. M10 on the cafe-stretched s3 golden sits on a rounding tie; exact rounding matches the baseline (1.959), while a float ratio of pence gave 1.9589. M5 is a balance and is reported as given.
